title: Bug: Continuous error logs after onie install - resolveTunnelQosMap: Failed to resolve QoS map for table TUNNEL_DECAP_TABLE tunnel IPINIP_TUNNEL type decap_dscp_to_tc_map
author: dgsudharsan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

We see continuous error logs below after onie install of latest master image


When we do ONIE install, there are no default QOS Maps. However we have a default Loopback IPv4 address. This results in  decap_dscp_to_tc_map getting configured due to PR  https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/21868

This will get resolved only after config qos reload or removing Loopback IP address.

Request to set the QoS map from ipinip.json only when it is present or change the verbosity of the logging level to avoid spamming the system immediately after bootup

### Steps to Reproduce

ONIE install of latest master image.
Issue can also be reproduced if we set Loopback IP without doing config qos reload.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual Behavior:
Errors in logs

Expected behavor:
No errors in logs.

comments.author: stephenxs
comments.body:
AFAIU, this j2 is rendered during swss initialization, when QoS configuration can be unavailable. As a result, the `decap_dscp_to_tc_map` won't be rendered
Once the system is up, the user executes `config qos reload` and QoS configuration is available, including the `DSCP_TO_TC` map. But we do not have a chance to re-render the ipinip.j2 template until the user executes `config reload` or any other reboot flow.

Is it fine?

comments.author: developfast
comments.body: @stephenxs yes this is rendered during swss initialization - on all my tests when booting up the device, if the qos config existed, `decap_dscp_to_tc_map` was set correctly. This code change would then only apply to onie bootups.
